## Verification

For mathematical result additions or changes, link the Lean file, fully
qualified theorem name, exact statement, and passing CI here. Every catalog
claim needs its own proof, including inactive historical results. Unformalized
proposals belong in issues with their sources, coordinates, and attribution.

UI, documentation, and other non-mathematical changes do not require a Lean
proof; mark mathematical checks not applicable when appropriate.

- [ ] `bun run archive:build`
- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `lake build` when Lean or mathematical claims changed
- [ ] Mathematical claims have linked Lean theorems and passing typed claim checks in CI
- [ ] Displayed expressions and decimal approximations agree with the exact Lean values
- [ ] Sources, original coordinates, discovery dates, and contributor roles are preserved
